description: Android activity class 'JobsActivityExtended' for displaying detailed job information, including customer details, parcel info, pickup and delivery locations, and handling navigation to a signature screen upon job completion.

classes.name: JobsActivityExtended
classes.description: This class extends AppCompatActivity to display detailed information about a specific job, manage its UI components, load data from saved JSON, and handle user interactions like marking a job as delivered.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, extracts job details from intent, loads page data, and sets click listener for the delivered button.

methods.name: loadPageData
methods.description: Reads JSON data from storage, parses it, and populates UI fields with job, customer, pickup, and dropoff details.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Ensures string input is not null or 'null' and returns sanitized string.

methods.name: cleanAddress
methods.description: Sanitizes address fields, appending comma if valid input.
